description.fun: A spiky sea urchin that scrapes seaweed off rocks with its five hard teeth and makes electricity as it digests. The charge is stored in its spines, and a broken-off spine keeps sparking for at least three hours. It's so timid that seaweed brushing against it makes it discharge in surprise. Its typing may nod to the sea urchin fossils once called thunderstones in southern England.
description.guide: An Electric-type sea urchin Pokémon that generates electricity by digesting seaweed and stores it in its spines. Pincurchin does not evolve.
description.tagline: A jumpy sea urchin with electrified spines
